implementation_entry_rule.all_families_all_modes_fail: stop before runtime candidates/PROTOCOL_R5 or further evaluation

scope: Only fixed normal-trained detector OR channels; R1 servo/torque and estimator packet are unchanged.
two_family_interpretation: SCALE has headroom; AR is an explicit negative diagnostic control, permanently ineligible from S2. Diagnostic evaluation never revives a failed mode/configuration.

redesign.allowed: Only causally identified implementation/mechanism repair after validation, with new committed addendum and fresh validation design377450; no blind tuning or changing any learned weight/threshold after collision results.

detector_gates.perturb_reference_FA_vs_matched_R1: no increase per case and total; physical subset and fresh noise subset reported separately
detector_gates.selection: Architecture independent; every preceding gate required. Choose among eligible per mode by development additional detected, then D4 additional detected, then lower maximum per-case measured p99, then protocol order. No runner-up promotion after holdout.
detector_gates.diagnostic_advancement: ALL four configurations receive fresh validation/development and D4/perturb replay even if permanently disqualified at a prior stage. Immediately record permanent non-adoption; diagnostic improvements cannot revive them or enter selection ranking.
detector_gates.control_scope: No control candidates; inherited control/stability/saturation gates are equality/noninterference checks, not a new control-gain claim.

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

relative_R1_interpretation.source: R1 also failed some R3 forced local and D4 saturation gates, so predeclare relative interpretation without changing numeric thresholds.
relative_R1_interpretation.R1_passing_points: candidate must pass original numeric gate
relative_R1_interpretation.R1_failing_points: must not be worse than paired R1
relative_R1_interpretation.FD: identical unchanged closed loop; no altered control candidate. Existing finite R3 results retained, not a new guarantee

G4.applies_to: positive masses, specifically final 8kg A/B; failure remains failure

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

implementation_proof.normal_model_active_capture: owned NormalResidualModel subclass, no self-capturing closure
implementation_proof.fresh_normal_equivalence: first new-audit reference per mode, all4 candidates vs paired R1
implementation_proof.validation: fresh full-loop ALL4 configurations and paired R1; all8 physical arrays bit equal; decisions exactly match offline monitor
implementation_proof.timing: all fresh validation full-loop cases, detector separately and paired wall/thread CPU; serial
implementation_proof.stability: No feedback/control/plant changes. New normal scale is clipped[0.25,1000], score EMA0.1 and bounded finite-support causal histories. Noninterference verified; no new closed-loop stability theorem.

cache_reuse.D4: Frozen R1 385 rows/mode:189 references,180 collisions,16 offsets; exact raw SHA+source+condition IDs; exposed diagnostic replay only after full-loop parity.
cache_reuse.physical_perturb: Frozen25 rows/mode with source ID and all stiffness/friction/seed values matched; no reclassification as fresh independent evidence.
cache_reuse.new_validation_development: Fresh R1 streams; validation ALL4 online+timing; development offline ALL4 only after exact online/offline/physical parity.
cache_reuse.fit_signals: Only role-filtered permitted observations; physical/evaluator data always separate.

perturbations.comparison: 25 exposed physical +9 genuinely new noise conditions; per-row exact matched R1, not the old34 matrix

holdout.marker: exclusive fsynced marker before real RNG, after freeze + Git-object verification
holdout.comparison: Chosen candidate and paired frozen R1 in ONE sealed batch; if effective candidate already R1 deduplicate. Report no new detector efficacy test in a fallback-only holdout.
holdout.failure: affected mode becomes frozen R1; no tuning, source edits, threshold edits, replacement, runner-up or second holdout

freeze.if_all_prefreeze_fail: skip new holdout and official, retain final3 byte-identical to R1
freeze.mutable_alias_exception: Only permitted current my_detector alias assembly before freeze if eligible; R1 source and all other198 R4 frozen paths remain exact. No adoption means all199 stay exact. Old manifests are never edited.
freeze.fallback: Only restore already-frozen R1 bytes after failure; no model/source/threshold edits or runner-up promotion.

official.stage: One original evaluator regression of the unchanged frozen provisional selection after the one holdout; if all prefrozen candidates fail, skip both.
official.prior_exposure: regression only, never independent efficacy or fit
official.after_failure: immutable R1 fallback only; no repair, retune, alternate promotion or retest

stop: local public commit above public baseline, before push
